LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_AbyssalHarpoonProjector: A heavy harpoon assembly for locking down elite targets. It pierces, slows and drags lesser enemies off their line.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_AshChoirRepeaterCore.de: A weapon core with a cycling ash-canticle feed. It throws short shard bursts through light targets, animals and dense abyssal waves.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ChoirArcEmitter.descrip: A secondary Choir system that adds a timed canticle strike against clustered enemies.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ChoirArcEmitter.label: choir arc emitter
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CinderMortarCore.descri: An indirect cinder mortar for pressure against clusters and static firing lines. It is poor once enemies break inside its dead zone.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CinderMortarCore.label: cinder mortar core
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CoolingLattice.descript: A bound heat-sink lattice that tightens the firing cycle of the installed main weapon at the cost of higher power draw.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CoolingLattice.label: cooling lattice
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CrowncoilGaussMinigun.d: An apex crowncoil gauss system for sustained suppression against elites and heavy swarms. Power hungry and weak inside its dead zone.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_NullArcDischarger.descr: A null-arc suppression system that burns shields, stuns machines and chains through clustered elite support.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_NullArcDischarger.label: null-arc discharger
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_PlasmaLanceCore.descrip: A weapon core with a sealed ultra-plasma channel. It fires slowly at long range and is built to crack armor, elite targets and early boss shells.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_PlasmaLanceCore.label: plasma lance core
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ResidueCapacitor.descri: A passive abyssal charge buffer that modestly improves turret reach and firing cadence.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ResidueCapacitor.label: residue capacitor
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftFlakBloom.descripti: A rift seed that blossoms into cutting fragments around the impact point, punishing light swarms and clustered groups.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftFlakBloom.label: rift flak bloom
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftNeedlerCore.descrip: A weapon core built around a rift-needle lattice. Once bound to a turret frame, it unleashes rapid bursts against light targets and dense swarms.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftNeedlerCore.label: rift needler core
A prism emitter that drives a narrow judgment cut through enemies standing in line.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_SepulcherRailCore.descr: A heavy rail core that charges sepulcher guides before one long-range penetrator shot against armored elites.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_SepulcherRailCore.label: sepulcher rail core
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_TargetingSigil.descript: A passive sigil that extends sighting geometry and steadies long-range tracking.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_TargetingSigil.label: targeting sigil
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_VesperLanceArray.descri: A saint-clean sanction lance for precise armor pressure: longer reaching than plasma and far faster than a sepulcher rail.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_VesperLanceArray.label: vesper lance array
LanguageData.ABY_TurretPlasmaLanceBolt.label: turret plasma bolt
